title: OpenDEA Maturity Component
description: A versioned, independently-governed package of reusable maturity content (CR-AM-10 §3). A MaturityComponent is published by one maturity model and consumed by others exclusively through typed, versioned ComponentReferences — a component is never inlined into a consumer; the reference IS the reuse. Kinds: dimension-package / criterion-package / level-expectation-package / evidence-requirement-package (vocabulary/component-kinds.yaml). Content entries reference the publishing model's own structure/evaluation artefacts (CR-AM-05A dimensions, criteria, level expectations, evidence requirements) by id:version. Phase 1 scope: component identity + publication metadata only; consumption semantics live in component-reference.schema.json.

kind.description: What the package contains. Controlled vocabulary: vocabulary/component-kinds.yaml. The kind determines which artefact type the content references must point at.

published_by.description: The maturity model that publishes and governs this component. The publishing model is the component's authority; consumers never fork the content.

status.description: Lifecycle status (e.g. draft / beta / stable / deprecated). Component deprecation follows the CR-AM-10 Phase 3 supersede semantics.

effective_date.description: ISO date from which this component version is effective.

review_date.description: ISO date by which this component version is due for review.

content.description: Versioned references into the publishing model's own artefacts (dimensions, criteria, level expectations, evidence requirements — matching the component kind). A component carries no inline maturity content: every entry is an id:version pointer.
